records.title: Florida Cosmetologist: Board of Cosmetology qualification, examination, and licensing routes
records.overview: Selected official DBPR and Florida Board of Cosmetology licensing steps for Florida Cosmetologists under Florida Statutes Chapter 477 (Cosmetology Act) and Florida Administrative Code Chapter 61G5. Represents practical education alternatives (including the 1,200-hour licensed cosmetology school training and out-of-state endorsement pathways), 4-hour Board-approved HIV/AIDS education, age and diploma prerequisites, electronic fingerprint screening (ORI FL924780Z), two-part Pearson VUE state licensing examination (Written Theory and Written Clinical), DBPR Form COSMO 1 initial application, and mandatory 10-hour biennial continuing education requirements. This is not a formal legal determination of eligibility; individual applications are evaluated directly by the Department.
records.review_note: Revision 1 establishes the verified DBPR Board of Cosmetology licensing pathway based on F.S. § 477.019, F.A.C. Rule 61G5, and DBPR Form COSMO 1 candidate guidance. Correctly models the 1,200-hour licensed cosmetology school curriculum, endorsement alternative under F.S. § 477.019(5), 4-hour HIV/AIDS course validity window, exact electronic fingerprinting ORI FL924780Z, two-part Pearson VUE examination (Written Theory and Written Clinical passing scores of 75), and 10-hour biennial continuing education renewal condition.

children.label: Complete 1,200 hours of Board-approved cosmetology training at a licensed Florida cosmetology school covering hair, skin, and nail services
children.condition: F.S. § 477.019(2); school must submit official completion verification directly to DBPR

children.label: Qualify via endorsement holding an active cosmetologist license from another state or jurisdiction with substantially equivalent standards
children.condition: Per F.S. § 477.019(5); submit certified license history and Form DBPR COSMO 2

children.label: Be at least 16 years of age or hold a high school diploma or its recognized equivalent
Complete a Board-approved four-hour HIV/AIDS continuing education course within two years prior to application
children.condition: F.S. § 477.019(2); official course completion certificate required

children.label: Submit electronic fingerprints through an FDLE-approved Livescan service vendor for criminal background screening
children.condition: Use DBPR Board of Cosmetology Originating Agency Identifier (ORI) FL924780Z

children.label: Submit completed DBPR Form COSMO 1 Application for Cosmetologist License by Examination with required state fees
children.condition: Submit online via DBPR Online Services or by mail with proof of education

children.label: Pass both parts of the Florida Cosmetology Licensure Examination administered by Pearson VUE: Written Theory and Written Clinical
children.condition: Scaled score of 75 or higher required on each examination portion

children.label: Endorsement candidates: verify department approval of out-of-state equivalent examination or credential
children.condition: Exempt from Florida examination if approved under F.S. § 477.019(5)

children.label: Complete 10 hours of Board-approved continuing education biennially to maintain and renew active license status
children.condition: Mandatory under F.S. § 477.019(7); includes sanitation, sterilization, laws and rules, and safety
